notes: Read SKILL.md (237 lines) in full; it is the only file in source. Guidance and C# samples for Azure.ResourceManager.ArizeAIObservabilityEval: create, get, list, update, and delete Arize AI organizations through Azure Resource Manager and Azure Marketplace.

Tells the agent to run `dotnet add package ... --version 1.0.0` (SKILL.md:18, pinned official NuGet package) and uses the developer's real Azure credentials (DefaultAzureCredential, optional service-principal env vars at SKILL.md:36-38) to create, update, and delete ARM resources (SKILL.md:106, 161, 168). The agent itself does not handle real secrets: credential and service calls live in sample code for the user's application. Medium for the package install and state-changing live-cloud operations; acceptable because the package is official and pinned, and every operation targets the user's own subscription as part of the requested task.

Creating an organization provisions an Azure Marketplace offer (SKILL.md:82-94) that can incur charges; DeleteAsync (SKILL.md:168) is shown without a confirmation step, so agents should confirm with the user before running create/delete against a real subscription. Sample user details (John Doe, john.doe@example.com) are placeholders.
